inputs.text: The hand-painted amphibian explorer runs energetically in place toward the right, alternating both legs in a continuous full running cycle. Strong forward lean, knees drive forward high, the other foot pushes backward and kicks up behind. Left leg and right leg take turns leading. Clear short airborne flight phases between footfalls. The body compresses on landing and springs upward on push-off; the rigid round helmet follows a smooth bouncing arc. The short teal cape streams behind and snaps in overlapping waves. The attached amber hip lantern swings with a delayed rhythm, red rope follows the hand. He keeps gripping the bone U-shaped tuning fork in the same hand throughout. Same original illustrated character, fixed camera, centered full body, generous margins, flat warm gray background. Lively continuous traditional 2D animation.
